environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with Function URL configured with AuthType=NONE. The function URL endpoint is publicly accessible at https://<url-id>.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/. No API Gateway, no CloudFront, no WAF in front. Any HTTP client can POST directly to the function URL without authentication. The Lambda execution role has network access to the RDS PostgreSQL instance via VPC configuration.

config.vpc_config: lambda in same VPC as RDS, security group allows 5432 outbound
